newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jagoda sees German joblessness falling in spring.
newsitem.headline: Jagoda sees German joblessness falling in spring.

text.p: German Federal Labour Office chief Bernhard Jagoda said, that the unemployment rate would fall in the spring after data showed January unemployment hit a new post-war record of 4.66 million.

"This figure cannot be made to look good, but it should also be recognised that the situation in January contains seasonal unemployment, and it follows that in spring we can reckon with a clear reduction," Jagoda told reporters.
Unadjusted unemployment surged by over half a million in January against December.
Meanwhile, the seasonally adjusted figure smashed market expectations by rising 160,000 to 4.32 million. Economists polled by Reuters had, on average, expected a rise of 52,000.
